title: Free Replacement under the Battery Replacement Warranties
content:
**Clause.** A battery covered by the Battery Replacement Warranties that fails inside its free period is replaced free with the same line and group, and the replacement is installed free. The warranty must be in status active when a free replacement is made. The replacement must be made no later than the end of the free replacement period counted from the battery purchase on the original ticket. Months are counted as calendar months from the anchor date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. The period is the line's free replacement months, or the line's commercial-use free months where the commercial-use terms apply. The failure must be shown by a test under the battery test rules, its cause must not be one of the line's excluded causes, and the number of free replacements already made on the warranty must be below the line's free replacements allowed; a further failure in the free period is handled as a prorated adjustment. The replacement keeps the original purchase date and warranty, so the warranty stays active. Where the line accepts a claim only for the battery in the vehicle it was sold for, the claim is accepted only for that battery in that vehicle.

## Conditions of a free replacement

| Condition | Shown by |
|---|---|
| The warranty is in status active | Crestline's record of the battery's warranty |
| The replacement date is no later than the last day of the free period | the purchase date on the original ticket, counted forward by the free period in calendar months |
| The battery has failed | a test under the battery test rules |
| The cause of failure is not an excluded cause of the line | the line's list of excluded causes |
| Free replacements already made on this warranty are fewer than the line allows | the free replacements recorded on this warranty over its life |
| For a line that accepts a claim only for the original vehicle: the battery is in the vehicle it was sold for | the vehicle the warranty was sold for |

## Periods by line (personal use)

| Line | Free replacement period (months) | Prorated through (months) | Free replacements allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | 24 | 24 | 1 |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | 30 | 60 | 1 |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | 36 | 72 | 1 |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | 36 | 72 | 2 |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | 48 | 84 | 2 |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 18 | 18 | 1 |

## Boundary illustration (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical 6-month period)

| Purchase date on the original ticket | Last day of the period | Replacement on that last day | Replacement on the following day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 10 September | within the period | outside the period |
| 31 August | the last day of February (31 February does not exist) | within the period | outside the period |

## What the replacement does

- The new battery is the same line and group, installed free.
- The warranty keeps its original purchase date; no new warranty opens, and every later period is still counted from the original ticket.
- The free replacement counts toward the number of free replacements allowed on that warranty.
